titles.romaji: Crayon Shin-chan: Buriburi Oukoku no Hihou
titles.english: Crayon Shin-chan: The Hidden Treasure of the Buri Buri Kingdom
titles.native: クレヨンしんちゃん ブリブリ王国の秘宝

description: A band of criminals want to get the treasure of the famous Treasure Island, but the key of the treasure chamber is guarded by a little kid. Then, they come to Japan and kidnap Shinosuke Nohara by mistake, who looks exactly like the little kid who has the key.
